schedule.caption:
📣 Want to make local korean friends and improve your korean speaking skills?

Join the 1st Cohort of MalMoim (말모임) — a cultural and language exchange community where Korean and international participants come together to learn languages and share cultures in a fun and meaningful way.

📍 Every Satdurday in Seoul, at Eunpyeong Youth Center (6week program)

Make real connections and boost your speaking confidence — not in a classroom, but through real conversations!

⸻

✅ Who is this for?

• People who want to make local korean friends

• Anyone interested in practicing korean through real-life conversation

• People passionate about sharing Korean language & culture

• Anyone looking for a warm and friendly community

⸻

✅ Program Details

• 📅 Duration: July 26 – August 30 (6 weeks)

• 🕒 Time: Every Satdurday, 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM (optional group hangouts after)

• 📍 Location: Eunpyeong Youth Center, Seoul

👉 Naver Map
https://naver.me/5FkfLwwx

• 💵 Participation Fee: 30,000 KRW for 6 weeks (paid on first day, in cash)

⸻

✅ Weekly Format

• 50 min: Korean conversation mentoring (korean friends will help you)

• 50 min: English language meetup (talk about random topics and be a english mentor for korean students)

• 40 min: Group cultural activity or creative games

• 🎈 Includes 2 outdoor events (picnic / activity day)

👥 We’ll form small teams (2 Koreans + 2 foreigners)

🎯 Each team has a bilingual team leader for smooth communication

⸻

✅ How to Join?

• 📝 Fill out this form: Google Form

https://forms.gle/Yp5kCLnZ2x3a1JUc9

• ⏰ Deadline: Tuesday, July 22(midnight)

• 📲 Final confirmation will be sent by text message on , July 23

spoke naturally in English,

Rather than just a “language exchange,”
Malmoim is really about
“having the experience of speaking naturally while meeting new people.”

We’re excited for all the moments we’ll create together over the next 6 weeks!

Our Thursday group of MALMOIM Season 9 has officially begun!

Bringing together people from different walks of life, we gathered in one space to share conversations, exchange perspectives, and make new connections.

What started with a few unfamiliar faces and shy introductions soon turned into laughter, meaningful conversations, and moments worth remembering.

Different backgrounds, different stories, but one thing in common — the joy of connecting with one another.

This is only the beginning of our journey together. Here’s to six weeks of new friendships, unforgettable memories, and meaningful connections. 🤍
